channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Qoraaga Ingiriiska M. John Harrison oo 81 jir ah ayaa ku guuleystay Abaalmarinta Booker
item.description: M. John Harrison ayaa noqday qofka ugu da'da weyn ee abid ku guuleysta Abaalmarinta Booker, isagoo buuggiisa "The End of Everything" ku helay abaalmarinta 2026 ee £50,000, sida ay Türkiye Today werisay.

item.title: Rubucda caalamka oo ku heshiisay inay fududeeyaan wada-hadallada doorashada Soomaaliya
item.description: Maraykanka, Britain, Turkiga iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa isku raacay inay fududeeyaan wada-hadallada doorashooyinka ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo la qorsheeyay 14-ka ilaa 18-ka November, sida ay Hiiraan Online sheegtay.

item.title: Bunny Shaw oo ka mid ah shanta u tartamaysa Ciyaaryahanadda Sanadka ee BBC 2026
item.description: BBC ayaa furtay codbixinta Ciyaaryahanadda Kubadda Cagta Haweenka ee Sanadka 2026, iyadoo liiska kama dambaysta ah ay ku jiraan Temwa Chawinga, Ewa Pajor, Alexia Putellas, Alessia Russo iyo Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw.

item.title: Kenya oo si joogto ah u xiraysa safaaraddeeda Bern ee dalka Switzerland
item.description: Safaaradda Kenya ee Bern ayaa ogeysiisay in adeegyada qunsuliyadda ay joogsanayaan 30-ka November 2026, iyadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay sheegtay in go'aanku qayb ka yahay dib-u-habeynta xafiisyada diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka, sida ay Capital FM werisay.

item.title: FIFPro World 11 ee ragga 2026: Harry Kane oo ka maqan, Messi-na markii 18aad ku jira
item.description: Ururka FIFPro ayaa shaaciyay kooxda ugu fiican adduunka ee ragga 2026, oo ay codeeyeen 19806 ciyaartoy; Harry Kane oo dhawaan ku guuleystay Ballon d'Or kuma jiro, halka Lionel Messi uu markii 18aad ku jiro, sida ay wariyeen FIFPro iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Cardinal Ameyu oo ugu baaqay hoggaamiyayaasha Suudaan iyo Koonfur Suudaan inay muwaadiniinta mudnaan siiyaan
item.description: Cardinal Stephen Ameyu Martin Mulla ayaa magaalada Torit ka sheegay in hoggaamiyayaasha labada dal ay danaha shacabka ka hormariyaan hammiga siyaasadeed, isagoo ku baaqay is-afgarad iyo wadahadal, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.

item.title: Krakow: Madaxweyne Nawrocki iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Tusk oo hoggaamiyay socod aamusan oo loogu talagalay dhibbanayaasha
item.description: Kumanaan qof ayaa habeenkii Isniinta ku socday bartamaha Krakow iyagoo xusaya dadkii lagu dilay rasaastii Sabtidii ka dhacday Fagaaraha Suuqa Weyn, waxaana hormuud ka ahaa Madaxweyne Karol Nawrocki iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Donald Tusk, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Tanzania: Qareennada Tundu Lissu oo sheegay in diyaarinta racfaanka xukunka 4 sano ay kala bar marayso
item.description: Qareennada guddoomiyaha xisbiga mucaaradka Chadema, Tundu Lissu, ayaa sheegay inay dhammeeyeen kala bar diyaarinta racfaanka xukunka 4 sano ee xabsi ah ee lagu riday dacwad kicin ah, sida ay werisay The Citizen.

item.title: NBA: Wembanyama oo 40 dhibcood dhaliyay, Spurs-na 9 guul oo isku xigta gaartay
item.description: San Antonio Spurs ayaa Isniintii Phoenix Suns kaga adkaatay 122-96, iyadoo Victor Wembanyama uu 25 daqiiqo gudahood ku dhaliyay 40 dhibcood, 11 rebound iyo 9 block, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport iyo AP.

item.title: Madaxa canshuuraha Koonfur Suudaan: iskaanarro ayaa shaqaalaha kastamka Nimule ka dhigi kara 50
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka Koonfur Suudaan, Rizig Dominic Samuel, ayaa sheegay in iskaanarro casri ah oo la geeyo xadka Nimule ay shaqaalaha kastamka ka dhimi karaan in ka badan 600 ilaa ku dhawaad 50, sida uu Eye Radio soo wariyay.

item.title: Australia oo shaacisay xeerar adag oo amniga AI ah iyo hay'ad cusub oo kormeerta
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaare Anthony Albanese ayaa ku dhawaaqay in shirkadaha AI ee ka shaqeeya Australia ay qasab ku noqon doonto inay soo sheegaan jebinta amniga, iyadoo la samaynayo hay'ad cusub oo kormeer ah, sida ay SBS iyo Sweden Herald soo wariyeen.

item.title: Faa'iidada ganacsiga Shiinaha oo dhaaftay 1 trillion oo doollar 10 bilood gudahood
item.description: Xogta kastamka Shiinaha ayaa muujisay in faa'iidada ganacsiga dalka ee Janaayo ilaa Oktoobar ay gaartay 1.04 trillion oo doollar, iyadoo dhoofinta ay kor u kacday baahida caalamiga ah ee qalabka AI, sida ay CNN iyo AFP soo wariyeen.

item.title: Codbixiyeyaasha California oo diiday canshuur hal mar ah oo la saarayo hantida bilyaneerada
item.description: Codbixiyeyaasha gobolka California ee Mareykanka ayaa diiday Proposition 40, oo ahayd canshuur 5% ah oo hal mar lagu soo rogi lahaa hantida bilyaneerada, taasoo noqon lahayd tii ugu horreysay ee noocaas ah ee Mareykanka, sida ay France 24 soo warisay.

item.title: Isbahaysiga Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu riday gantaallo Xuuthiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh
item.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirku uu burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah iyo gantaal cruise ah oo loo ganay caasimadda Riyadh, iyo gantaal kale oo loo ganay koonfurta boqortooyada, saacado kadib weerar lagu qaaday dhuumaha saliidda Bari-Galbeed.

item.title: Los Angeles: Diyaarad Air France ah oo leexasho khaldan ku gashay waddada diyaarad kale
item.description: Diyaarad Air France ah oo ka duulaysay garoonka Los Angeles ayaa leexasho aan la oggolayn samaysay, taasoo dhigtay waddada diyaarad American Airlines ah oo kacaysay, sida ay sheegtay Hay'adda Duulista Mareykanka (FAA).

item.title: Amnesty oo El Salvador iyo Haiti ka dalbatay inay shaaciyaan heshiiska 2000 askari
item.description: Ururka Amnesty International ayaa Isniintii ka codsaday El Salvador iyo Haiti inay soo bandhigaan heshiiska lagu dirayo qiyaastii 2000 askari oo Salvadoran ah oo loo diray Haiti, isagoo ka digay khatarta xuquuqda aadanaha, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Maxkamad Nairobi ah oo hakisay iibka khamriga ee internetka ilaa la buuxiyo shuruudo adag
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Nairobi ayaa soo saartay amarro ku meel gaar ah oo hakinaya iibinta iyo geynta khamriga ee barnaamijyada internetka ee magaalada, ilaa ganacsatadu ka helaan ruqsad oo ay xaqiijiyaan da'da iibsadaha, sida uu werisay Capital FM Kenya.

item.title: Kameruun: Biya oo doorashooyinka baarlamaanka iyo golaha deegaanka u qabtay 7 Febraayo
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kameruun Paul Biya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in doorashooyinka baarlamaanka iyo golaha deegaanka, oo laba jeer dib loo dhigay, la qaban doono 7 Febraayo 2027, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Qantas oo 850 shaqo oo xafiis u wareejinaysa shirkadda Accenture, intooda badan India
item.description: Shirkadda diyaaradaha Australia ee Qantas ayaa sheegtay in 850 shaqo oo xafiis ah loo wareejin doono shirkadda la-talinta ee Accenture, inta badanna loo raro India, iyadoo dardargelinaysa maalgelinta AI, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Cricket Australia oo diiday dib u furista baaritaankii fadeexaddii kubadda ee 2018
item.description: Cricket Australia ayaa sheegtay inaysan dib u furi doonin baaritaankii fadeexaddii xoqidda kubadda ee 2018, kadib eedeymihii Usman Khawaja ee buuggiisa, iyadoo sheegtay inaysan jirin sabab xooggan, sida ay werisay The Guardian.

item.title: MLB: Kevin McGonigle iyo Sal Stewart oo lagu doortay ciyaartoyda cusub ee ugu fiican 2026
item.description: Kevin McGonigle oo u ciyaara Detroit Tigers ayaa ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Rookie of the Year ee American League, halka Sal Stewart oo u ciyaara Cincinnati Reds uu ku guuleystay tan National League, sida ay CBS Sports iyo The Athletic sheegeen.

item.title: NTSB oo soo saartay qalabka duuba codka diyaaraddii Learjet ee ku burburtay Florida
item.description: Baarayaasha hay'adda NTSB ee Mareykanka ayaa soo saaray qalabka duuba codka qolka duuliyaha ee diyaaraddii Learjet ee 1 November ku burburtay Palm Beach County, Florida, kuna dhinteen 9-kii qof ee saarnaa, sida ay CNN sheegtay.

item.title: Manchester United oo la filayo inay xilka ka qaado tababaraha Michael Carrick
item.description: Manchester United ayaa sii kordhaya fursadaha ay ku eryi karto tababaraheeda Michael Carrick, sida ay BBC Sport iyo Sky Sports sheegeen, inkastoo aan weli go'aan kama dambays ah la gaarin.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in Jensen Huang u diiday inuu ogaa in haweeneydu basaasad Shiine ahayd
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu Isniintii la hadlay madaxa Nvidia Jensen Huang, kaasoo u diiday inuu ogaa in haweeneyda uu xiriirka la lahaa ay ahayd basaasad Shiine ah, sida ay CNN sheegtay.

item.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo Buenos Aires kula kulmay shan qof oo ka badbaaday xadgudub wadaaddo
item.description: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa maalintii labaad ee booqashadiisa Argentina si gaar ah ula kulmay shan qof oo ka badbaaday xadgudubyo galmo oo ay geysteen wadaaddo, wuxuuna ballanqaaday inuu xoojiyo ilaalinta, sida ay Al Jazeera sheegtay.

item.title: Tom Brady oo joojiyay xiriirkiisii kooxda Birmingham City
item.description: Halyeeyga NFL-ka Tom Brady ayaa soo afjaray xiriirkiisii kooxda Birmingham City oo hoggaanka u haysa horyaalka Championship, 3 sano kadib, sida ay BBC Sport iyo The Athletic sheegeen.

item.title: Falanqeyn: Iskaashiga milatari ee Türkiye wuxuu Soomaaliya ka caawin karaa inay amnigeeda gacanteeda ku qabato, sida uu qoray Dr. Ismaaciil Cali Shiikhnuur
item.description: Dr. Ismaaciil Cali Shiikhnuur, oo horey u ahaa madaxa shaqaalaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, ayaa falanqayn uu qoray ku sheegay in iskaashiga milatari ee Türkiye uu Soomaaliya ka caawin karo inay buuxiso haldaloolada amni ee ka dhalan kara baxa ciidamada Uganda iyo isbeddelka howlgalka Midowga Afrika, balse uu ku adkaystay in Türkiye ay tahay saaxiib dhisa awoodda, ee aysan beddel u ahayn ciidamada qaranka.

item.title: Erdogan: Turkiga wuxuu Gabar ka helay laba goobood oo saliid ah oo cusub
item.description: Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa sheegay in Turkiga uu helay laba goobood oo saliid ah oo cusub oo ku yaalla gobolka Gabar ee koonfur-bari, kuwaas oo lagu qiyaasay 135 milyan oo foosto, sida ay Türkiye Today sheegtay.

item.title: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Qubrus oo isku raacay furitaanka laba marin oo cusub oo xadka jasiiradda ah
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Giriigga Qubrus Nikos Christodoulides iyo hoggaamiyaha Turkiga Qubrus Tufan Erhurman ayaa ku heshiiyay inay furaan laba marin oo cusub oo ka gudba xariiqda kala qaybisa jasiiradda, sida ay Al Jazeera sheegtay.

item.title: Arsène Wenger oo go'aan kama dambays ah ka gaaraya inuu la tartamo Infantino doorashada FIFA
item.description: Arsène Wenger, tababarihii hore ee Arsenal, ayaa ku dhow inuu go'aan kama dambays ah ka gaaro inuu u tartamo madaxweynaha FIFA isagoo la tartamaya Gianni Infantino, iyadoo heshiiska shaqo ee uu FIFA kula jiro uu dhammaanayo dhammaadka sannadkan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic.
